scope: Historical archive-only 2-D Peskin operator and cylinder comparison (m18131), plus the separate partial solid-interior attempt (m20490). Original NumPy reference adaptation is not native JAX; historical operator agreement did not establish physical drag acceptance. The later 3-D sphere studies at benchmarks/xval_ib3d_diffuse_interface_mdf and benchmarks/xval_peskin_stencil_mdf_r2 are distinct and unchanged.

criteria.stencil_identity: 1e-12 absolute on weights, identical non-zero node keys, 2-D and 3-D
criteria.oss_vs_tl_force: 15% relative on sum_x F_grid at matched convergence (n_iter = 10) and h = 0.9 cells
criteria.iface_slip: 15% relative interface slip; a PASS requires the slip below the bar, not merely a small arm-to-arm difference
criteria.end_to_end: 15% on Cd between arms (literature is an informational column, the setup is not claimed to be unbounded-flow accurate)
